pairs.evidence: features/schranka/useSchranka.ts:115 Every follow button subscribes to the entire inbox snapshot, so visit and watermark changes rerender consumers that only need one entity's followed status.

techniques.evidence: features/schranka/useNews.ts:34 Deduplication expires after 60 seconds even when the original request remains pending, permitting duplicate identical flights; an older failure can subsequently delete the replacement cache entry.
features/schranka/useNews.ts:95 The request session depends on its query identity, and cleanup makes its late continuations inert; no caller-supplied callback restarts it.
features/schranka/followCodec.ts:7 The inspected paths use browser-local follows and public entity queries, without a signed-in identity or account-switch lifecycle.

features/schranka/useNews.ts:88 Mounted readers fetch when query dependencies change; TTL expiry neither notifies them nor triggers revalidation, and server changes have no delivery path to those readers.
features/schranka/FollowButton.tsx:54 A button needs one entity's followed status but receives a hook subscribed to the whole snapshot, without a declared projection or observed-read narrowing.
features/schranka/useSchranka.ts:120 Following writes synchronous client-owned truth; it does not paint a guess awaiting remote authority.

features/schranka/followCodec.ts:194 Malformed JSON silently becomes the empty default without a diagnostic distinguishing corruption from first run, despite the realized version and future-payload protections.
features/schranka/useToday.ts:31 The module owns mutable day, listener, and timer state and reaps the timer on last unsubscribe, but provides no explicit test-reset hatch required by the technique.

features/schranka/useNews.ts:98 Pending, obsolete, and failed reads collapse to the same null result, while the request layer discards failure evidence instead of retaining an explicit operation status and cause.
features/schranka/useSchranka.ts:115 Mutations have a central owner, but consumers subscribe to the complete state rather than their narrowest projection.

pairs.evidence: features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:99 The page retains its initial aggregate and replaces it after its own successful vote, but mounted readers have no mechanism to learn about other submissions or refreshed aggregate props.

techniques.evidence: features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:416 The page has no replaceable asynchronous read slot, and its vote button is disabled while the single submission runs.

features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:60 The storage subscription has stable module-scope identity and removes the exact registered callback; page state changes do not redefine the subscription.
features/landing/referendum/actions.ts:7 Voting and aggregate loading are anonymous public operations, without account-scoped client caches or identity transitions.

features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:99 Own-write reconciliation is present, but initialAggregate is only a state initializer; later props and other voters' changes do not update the held aggregate.
features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:90 External-store snapshots are independent primitive values, not shared multifield results requiring read-set inference.
features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:129 The aggregate is updated from the authority's response only after awaiting a successful submission; there is no optimistic paint or rollback.

features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:52 Module scope contains immutable constants and subscription functions; mutable ballot and aggregate state belong to component instances.

features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:116 The failed state carries no evidence: invalid results, unavailable storage, and rejected promises all become the same bare value, and retries do not clear that failure when starting.

features/landing/referendum/ReferendumPage.tsx:74 The lens ranking is derived from authoritative props and current weights rather than stored separately, while page-specific ballot state remains local.
